github_repository_types: Number of GitHub repositories by type

Source: R/github_repository_types.R
github_repository_types.Rd

One row per organisation, visibility, repository type and year of creation, with the number of repositories. All repositories of all organisations in github_organisations are counted, private repositories and student work included. The table holds no repository name.

Usage

github_repository_types

Format

A tibble with 5 variables

organisation

Login of the GitHub organisation.

visibility

Visibility of the repositories on the snapshot date. Levels: public, private.

repository_type

Type of the repositories. Levels: learner repository (one repository per learner in a course or workshop), organisation profile, data package (R package with a data folder), student project (name or description points to a thesis or semester project), manuscript, proposal or report, teaching and training (course and workshop material), website and communication, template, group management, software (other R and Python packages), hardware, research project (everything else).

created_year

Year the repositories were created.

repos

Number of repositories.

Source

GitHub REST API, read with data-raw/data_processing_github.R.

Details

The type comes from rules on the repository name, the files at the top level of the repository, its topics, its main language and the purpose of its organisation. The first rule that matches decides, in the order of the levels below. The rules are rough: a thesis project that is named after its topic counts as a research project or as hardware. Single public repositories are corrected by hand in data-raw/github_repository_types.csv.
